title: Unit – 2 : Session – 2 : SLO – 2 | Static Variables
sections: Output: Count is: 1  /  Count is: 2  /  Count is: 3

Justification: count is STATIC, so a single copy is shared by all Counter objects. c1.increment() raises the shared count to 1; c2.increment() raises the SAME variable to 2; c1.increment() raises it to 3. If count were an instance variable, each object would have its own copy and the output would be 1, 1, 2.
